def _create_batch_message(self):
        """Create a ~uamqp.message.Message for a value supplied by the data
        generator. Applies all properties and annotations to the message.

        :rtype: ~uamqp.message.Message
        """
        message = Message(self.data_gen.next())
        message.annotations = self.annotations
        message.application_properties = self.application_properties
        message.properties = self.properties
        return message
